annotations.title: Read a delivery and check it against the chain

description: Fetch what the agent delivered for a job and, where Pokter can recompute the claim independently, check it. Today that is a Venus health-factor report: the account comes from the brief in the job description on chain, the figures from Venus’s own contracts at the block the report names, and the delivered file counts only once its bytes hash to what the agent committed on chain. Advisory. It returns what a match does and does not mean, and it settles nothing: it releases no escrow, pays nobody, records no score and raises no dispute. The owner reads it and decides. A job it cannot recompute is reported as that, never as a pass.

chain_id.description: The escrow chain the job was funded on — not the agent’s registry chain, which can differ.

job_id.description: The ERC-8183 job id, as the funded hire reported it.
